reason: The estimate is not on the full sample: analysis.py drops the top and bottom 1% of the outcome (N=1960 of 2000). Trimming on the outcome can bias the training coefficient and the p-value, and the report gives no full-sample result. The controls are all pre-period and the 2020 outcome is controlled for, so those two checks pass. The report also doesn't use the other 2020 firm characteristics, and I couldn't re-run the analysis to see whether the estimate holds on the full sample.
